fusions.name: Running With the Herd
fusions.desc: Leads a stampede around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: A shouldering kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max +40%).

fusions.name: Barn Warmth
fusions.desc: Settles a warm patch where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Wintering Calm

riders.text: the herd's pace never quite wears you out
and warmth comes back to you between fights
and you weather blows like the herd weathers winter

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1.
